about: Second fresh-site eval: goals on sites the navigator was never tuned on, many not in English, and goal types beyond help articles (a contact number, a price, a form, a status page, a timetable). For finding new kinds of failure. Each case starts at its site's home page. A run succeeds when the navigator reports Reached and the final URL or title contains one of the keywords (and none of `avoid`). When the navigator hands back for text, the eval types the case's `query` and Enter, as the calling agent would, up to twice. Run with `aibrowse eval navigator --suite evals/fresh2.json`.
